body: CHANGELOG updated in TYLER: feat(episodes): x05 'The Only Airplanes Are Buses' — third GPT-2-assisted render experiment, first staged as a FULL episode (not just a cold open). Seeded from the S01E02 experiment's own emergent line ('the only airplanes to do anything are buses') rather than an existing broadcast script -- a render seeding a new render. Same 5-call ramp (16/32/64/128/256 max_tokens, ~11 min total). Final pass fabricated a full archival citation format with two named 'witnesses' (KINGSTON, JOHN / DREIFER, PAUL) and a Kennedy/Johnson/Vietnam conflation -- built the episode around that as its actual subject: a fabricated citation that reads as real if nobody checks. Placed as Series X, unnumbered (x05), documentary-crew format, explicitly not touching Season 6's Hastings Street/Constructions continuity. (sess-20260809-1420-e9d3d7f8)
